local_reimplementations.name: LoginCard
local_reimplementations.notes: app-local full reimplementation of narduk-auth's AuthLoginCard (own zod schema, useAuth()/startOAuth() calls). 0 usage found under <LoginCard> OR <AuthLoginCard> tags anywhere in this app's .vue/.ts source. Nuxt's default components-dir folder-prefix convention (confirmed active in this app -- see components bsf/SiteHeader.vue -> <BsfSiteHeader>, bsf/MilestonePage.vue -> <BsfMilestonePage> with 8 hits) would register this file as <AuthLoginCard>, the SAME tag name narduk-auth's own layer registers -- if that resolves as expected, this local file silently shadows/replaces the library component wherever narduk-auth's own login.vue page (served automatically, no local page file exists) renders <AuthLoginCard>. Not confirmed by a build/component-manifest trace (out of scope for a read-only grep survey); flagged as the single most consequential finding in this repo for the orchestrator to verify directly.

defect_history.summary: SSR/hydration mismatch: day counter showed wrong value for UTC+ timezone users during early local hours, because atLocalMidnight() used JS local-time getters that resolve to UTC on the Cloudflare Worker but user-local time on the client, in both BsfPublicProfileBody.vue and dashboard/index.vue

top_extraction_candidates.name: LoginCard/RegisterCard/ExchangePanel duplication risk
top_extraction_candidates.why: 606 combined LOC of local components with the exact same names narduk-auth's own layer would assign them (AuthLoginCard/AuthRegisterCard/AuthExchangePanel via Nuxt's folder-prefix convention, confirmed active elsewhere in this app), zero measured usage under any tag, and a live dependency on narduk-auth 1.25.4 -- this needs a direct (non-grep) check by whoever owns the estate-wide plan: either dead code to delete, or a silent override of the shared library's own auth UI that every other app assumes is safe to change centrally

top_extraction_candidates.name: sobrietyTime.ts
top_extraction_candidates.why: 9-consumer duration formatter with a real, closed SSR-hydration defect (issue #7) rooted in a local-time-vs-UTC bug -- exactly the class of defect a shared, audited date/duration formatter should prevent from being reinvented per-app

top_extraction_candidates.name: public profiles limit-only list
top_extraction_candidates.why: truncates silently past 20 rows with no next-page mechanism -- same unbounded/undersized-list risk class flagged in mybo-at-v2 issue #14 and narduk-nvr's members endpoint

notes: Only L7 repo without @nuxt/ui as a direct dependency and the only one with tailwindcss as a direct dependency -- has its own UI_PLAN.md-driven design system, though <UApp> in app.vue confirms Nuxt UI is still present and used transitively. This app DOES adopt some narduk-core UI (AppConfirmModal x3, LayerNetworkFooter x1), unlike the other three cloned L7 repos which show zero narduk-core component tag usage. The auth/{LoginCard,RegisterCard,ExchangePanel}.vue finding is the standout result of this lane and needs a maintainer/build-level check, not just grep, to resolve.
